test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

EYXJ : IGBR : : CRFQ : GZJY: : ZIQM : ?
solution:
The positional values of English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

EYXJ is coded as IGBR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3e4f0b058e8ea8a35b95cf797c4d15c0b9a9e805613c3488aa72ccfa7a870d5.png] 

And,

CRFQ is coded as GZJY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bbc00d0bdd5c025b69771198363268430a03deb6fae21942544b2cac8785fc7.png] 

Similarly,

ZIQM will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f1b935e5d1f9581efd00a8317fd294ac9d13f03c5d30ab1e7ab5778559c4ab1.png] 

Hence, **"****DQUU" **is the **correct answer.**
